1.mascotDialogue: Arrow in directed graph mean exactly one thing — you can go this way. Say nothing at all about whether you can come back.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 8 set exactly one cell in matrix. Directed edge only ever write adjacency[u][v] — never adjacency[v][u].

3.mascotDialogue: Every arrowhead point one way. This particular loop happen to form cycle, but each edge stay, individually, one-directional.

4.mascotDialogue: This the number one most common directed-graph mistake — treating one-way arrow like she secretly run both way. She don't. Visual only ever draw direction you actually set.
